verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents a centralized cap table that covers every named instrument: preferred shares and share classes, certificated and uncertificated shares with reissue and signing workflows, SAFEs added directly to the cap table, and ESOP management with ASC 718 and Form 3921 support. Stakeholder access, permissions, a data room and downloadable reports support external reliance, and a community user confirms real-time updates. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of option-grant issuance mechanics, explicit auditor-facing access or audit-trail evidence, and independent corroboration beyond a single community anecdote.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote: Eqvista replaces manual spreadsheets with a centralized platform where companies can manage ownership, equity transactions, compliance, documents, and stakeholder access in one place.
